statement: Lambda's published on-demand GPU cloud list prices as of 2026-08-11: B200 SXM6 $6.69-$6.99 per GPU-hour, H100 SXM $3.99-$4.29 per GPU-hour, A100 SXM 80GB $2.79 per GPU-hour.
why: Published rental rates for current and prior-generation NVIDIA accelerators are a level read on what compute costs a renter; the page states no prior price or change, so this is a static level rather than a directional signal.

impact.mechanism: List rental rates set the cost of accessing NVIDIA accelerators without buying them, which links neocloud pricing power to merchant-GPU hardware value; with no baseline the level alone carries no direction.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA B200 SXM6 $6.69/GPU-hour; NVIDIA H100 SXM $3.99/GPU-hour; NVIDIA A100 SXM 80GB $2.79/GPU-hour

confidence.basis: Vendor's own published list page (secondary tier), single publisher, no reserved or contract pricing shown.

dispersion: Per-GPU rate varies by instance size: H100 SXM $3.99/hr at 8x versus $4.29/hr at 1x; B200 SXM6 $6.69/hr at 8x versus $6.99/hr at 1x.
